metric_definitions.goal_found_rate: Number of episodes where goal ever detected / N; crash after detection does not remove goal detection
metric_definitions.goal_step: First goal detection joint timestep (one A1+B1+B2 cycle), null if not detected
metric_definitions.coverage60_step: First joint timestep reward-eligible coverage >= 0.600, null if not reached
metric_definitions.full_coverage60_step: First joint timestep entire-search-area coverage >= 0.600, null if not reached
metric_definitions.final_coverage: Terminal core.current_coverage_ratio() over entire search area
metric_definitions.missing_steps: Time means condition on reaching the goal/coverage; null failures are excluded. Reach rates are always reported.
metric_definitions.paired: Same environment and seed; method-specific trajectories with deterministic policy inference
